integrity: The mathematical claim is derived from the stated published recurrence. A finite numerical replay is supporting evidence only and is not used as a proof of the infinite asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Scalar linear inclusion with T=0 and 0<eta*lambda<1; no claim for distributed coupling, nonlinear problems, or restarted/retuned variants. Exact logarithmic exponents are proved, but a full leading asymptotic constant for z_k is not claimed.
title: A polynomial strong-monotonicity tail in Fast Fixed-Point acceleration
